descriptionHtml:
COUGAR EGY T29 Wired Gaming Controller - White (PlayStation Ergonomic Design / USB Wired / PC & PS4 Compatible / 6-Axis Gyroscope / Dual Vibration Motors / Programmable Macro Back Paddles / Turbo Speed Function / 3.5mm Audio Port)

Take full control of your gameplay with the COUGAR EGY T29 Wired Gaming Controller in White, available at Turbo Computer Egypt. Designed with PlayStation DualShock/DualSense ergonomics and non-slip textured grips, this controller offers plug-and-play USB connectivity for PC and PS4, integrated 6-axis motion sensors, dual asymmetric vibration motors, customizable Turbo execution, programmable rear macro paddles (M1/M2), and an integrated 3.5mm headset jack for immersive gaming sessions.
